radiology_report:
Jeroen Bosch Ziekenhuis ('s-Hertogenbosch)
Imaging Department
Date: 15 Dec 2024
Exam: mpMRI Prostate

Clinical indication: Elevated PSA 7.3 ng/mL. Prior biopsy Gleason 3+4 (ISUP GG2).

FINDINGS:
Prostate volume 64.0 mL. On T2-weighted imaging, a focal hypo-intense lesion is identified in the right peripheral zone, measuring approximately 18 x 14 x 12 mm. The lesion demonstrates restricted diffusion on high b-value DWI (b=1400) with corresponding hyperintensity on the ADC map. Dynamic contrast-enhanced (DCE) sequences show early, intense focal enhancement in the same region. No extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion is visualized.

IMPRESSION:
PI-RADS 5 lesion in the right peripheral zone.
PSA density: 0.11 ng/mL/mL.
Clinical stage: cT1c.
csPCa predicted probability: 0.854789.

previous_notes.author: Dr. H. Martens (GP)
previous_notes.text: Patient presented with elevated PSA of 6.6 ng/mL. After discussion of the risks and benefits, a repeat prostate biopsy was scheduled. The patient was informed about the procedure and provided with pre-biopsy instructions. The daughter was copied on the referral letters as per the patient's request.

pathology_report:
Biopsy 1 (Jul 2022): The histological examination reveals adenocarcinoma of the prostate. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. The tumour exhibits an acinar growth pattern. A cribriform pattern is present. Perineural invasion is identified. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, right.

Biopsy 2 (Jan 2025): The histological examination reveals adenocarcinoma of the prostate. The Gleason score is 3+4, corresponding to ISUP grade group 2. The tumour exhibits an acinar growth pattern. A cribriform pattern is present. Perineural invasion is identified. The tumour is located in the peripheral zone, right.

Summary: The histological findings remain stable across both biopsy timepoints, with persistent ISUP grade group 2 disease.

AI-predicted ISUP grade group (digital pathology): grade group 3.
